summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The DB Gold Short Exchange Traded Notes (DGZ) is an exchange-traded product that mostly invests in gold commodities. The fund provides monthly inverse exposure to the performance of gold futures contract. The notes index selects contracts based on the shape of the futures curve to minimize contango. DGZ was launched on Feb 27, 2008 and is issued by DB.
